messages:
Maya (AE): HelioPay submitted a SIG and an extended vendor questionnaire. They want a POC by next Wed and details on encryption-at-rest (KMS/HSM), SOC2, and private deployment options. Intake doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/heliopay-intake :point_up:
Jordan (SE): Can you paste the POC scope? Data sensitivity? expected rps/qps? avg payload size?
Maya (AE): No PHI. Payment metadata + tokenized IDs. ~50 rps peak, payloads ~2–3KB, low-latency is a hard ask.
Priya (Sales Ops): Budget? Are we quoting Dedicated reserved vs Hosted usage for POC/POC->prod?
Maya (AE): Customer hasn't committed budget. Claire asked for a ballpark for both options so they can decide.
Jordan (SE): For 50 rps and low-latency I'd recommend Dedicated with burst capacity + KV caching. I can sketch a config.
Sam (Security Eng): I'll own the questionnaire intake. Need: customer contact, SOC2 report (pdf), and confirmation on key custody (Redwood-managed KMS vs customer KMS/HSM).
Maya (AE): Claire@heliopay.com. They prefer Redwood-managed keys but are open to customer KMS in VPC for Private.
sec-intake-bot: New intake created: INT-2290012345 — assigned to security queue.
Sam (Security Eng): Assigned. I'll start a CAIQ mapping and call out gaps. If HSM custody required, note we support customer-controlled KMS/HSM only on Private deployments.
Jordan (SE): Quick draft config to baseline perf/pricing:
```text
model: 13B (causal)
deployment: dedicated
gpu: 1xH100
batching: 8
kv_cache: enabled
kms: aws-kms (customer-vpc)
```
Jordan (SE): That should hit latency SLOs with the right tuning.
Priya (Sales Ops): Need token estimates to run a price comparison. Jordan — rough tokens per request?
Jordan (SE): Avg ~2k tokens/request -> 50 rps => ~100k tokens/sec? wait math: 2k * 50 = 100k tokens/sec -> ~6M tokens/min. Use that as a high-level.
Priya (Sales Ops): Got it. I'll produce a hosted vs dedicated ballpark for Claire in ~30m and include monthly + POC duration options.
Sam (Security Eng): One more blocker: HelioPay wants a recent penetration test report (external) within 2 weeks. Can Sales ask for PT scope and if they accept our third-party report?
Maya (AE): On it. I'll ping Claire for PT scope and whether Redwood's pen-test package is acceptable.
Jordan (SE): Note: if PT includes infra-level tests against shared infra we may need to move them to Dedicated or Private for the test window.
Maya (AE): Understood.
Sam (Security Eng): I'll start the controls matrix and highlight any CAIQ items that need ops changes (e.g., key rotation, logging retention, access review cadence).
Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll update once Claire replies. :thumbsup:
